correctness.rationale: On the dense span of Fock kernels, exact Gaussian evaluation produces the positive Gram kernel D exp[P(z²+wbar²)/2+Q z wbar]. For Q-P<1, a squeezed Gaussian generating basis diagonalizes the induced positive trace-class operator with all eigenvalues lambda0*q^n; the Gaussian diagonal integral agrees with their sum. At equality, Bargmann conjugation gives (1/r) multiplication by exp(-eta x²), establishing bounded noncompact endpoint with continuous spectrum. For Q-P>1 normalized imaginary coherent states have divergent norms. Verified parameter inequalities, the geometric trace identity and the boundary constant independently in CHECK.py.

value.rationale: The source derives a necessary coherent-state threshold but leaves operator-level sufficiency and singular spectrum undecided for the strict parameter region. The result supplies a natural complete spectral classification for positive radial Gaussian symbols, including exact all-Schatten singular numbers below, a previously unidentified noncompact continuous-spectrum endpoint, and unboundedness beyond. This fills a motivated gap in the paper rather than an arbitrary finite tabulation. The known numerical threshold is explicitly credited and not offered as an independently novel discovery.
